summary: Iteration 20 — All 15 spec items validated. Backend pytest 13/13 PASS (test_iteration20.py): /api/translate/public dictionary fast-path (Bonjour→dict, Mbote auto-detect lg-fr), AI fallback for long phrase 'Bonne nuit mon enfant chéri' returned valid Lingala via method=ai (cached after first call), no-auth required confirmed (200 not 401), rate-limit 429 triggered within 25 calls, /api/translate/sample-words returns 20 items with {lingala,french,theme,image} and no _id leak, empty text rejected 422. Drive endpoints: /drive/auth-url 401 unauthenticated → 200 authed with valid https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth URL containing client_id and drive.file scope, /drive/status returns {connected:false,email:null} for new account, /drive/disconnect idempotent (success=true even with no creds), /drive/upload returns 400 'Drive non connecté' when no creds, 401 unauth. Frontend (Playwright): /traduction-lingala loads without auth, H1 = 'Traduction Français ↔ Lingala', translator-card + dir-fr + dir-lg + swap + copy + speak buttons all clickable without JS errors, sample-grid populated with ≥10 word cards, error message correctly shown on 429 rate-limit. Navbar 'Traduire' link + Footer 'Traduire Lingala' link both visible and navigate to /traduction-lingala. /app/parametres (authed via mongosh-injected session): drive-card visible, drive-connect button visible, clicking it triggers GET /api/drive/auth-url returning 200 + Google OAuth URL, browser then successfully redirects to accounts.google.com sign-in page (full OAuth initiation flow proven). Assistant.jsx code review confirms drive-row, save-to-drive, google-drive-link testids are wired correctly (UI not exercised live to avoid Mammouth credit consumption).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2501 lines (grew from 1878 in iter19 → +623 lines for translate-public + Drive OAuth). Split into routers (e.g., routers/translate.py, routers/drive.py) is overdue. Repeatedly flagged since iter14.

_translate_rl is in-memory dict — rate-limit state lost on backend restart, and not shared across multi-worker deployments. Acceptable for single-instance preview but should move to Redis or Mongo TTL collection for production.
_drive_states (OAuth state→user_id map) is also in-memory; if backend restarts mid-OAuth flow the callback fails with invalid_state. Persist to Mongo with TTL index for resilience.
drive_credentials stored with plaintext refresh_token in MongoDB. Encrypt at rest (Fernet/AES with key in env) — Google refresh tokens grant long-lived Drive access.

Translate AI fallback prompt asks Claude to respond JSON-only but parse uses non-greedy regex {[^{}]*} which fails on nested JSON; current prompts produce flat JSON so OK, but brittle. Consider stricter JSON parsing or response_format='json'.

translate_public uses french_norm/lingala_norm fields on db.words — verify migration/seed has populated these normalized fields for ALL existing words, otherwise dictionary fast-path silently misses many entries (test confirmed Bonjour matched, but full coverage not audited).
/api/translate/sample-words returns up to 20 items but no ordering — different calls may return different sets; consider sort by 'order' or 'created_at' for stable UX.

drive_upload allows mime_type 'application/octet-stream' which bypasses the allow-list check (since it's IN the allow-list). Effectively any binary can be uploaded by setting that mime; consider tightening to specific media types only.
